questions.q: True/False: All Turner streak gonads should be removed prophylactically.
opts: True - after puberty in every case
questions.exp: Non-malignant streak gonads should not be removed; only the streak ovary plus dysgenetic testis combination is removed.

questions.sec: Conditions in the Presence of a Uterus

questions.exp: Horseshoe kidney appears under investigations as an association to seek, not in the features list.

questions.sec: Conditions in the Presence of a Uterus

questions.sec: Conditions in the Presence of a Uterus

questions.exp: 'Management: Pulsatile GnRH'.

questions.q: Why is pulsatile rather than continuous GnRH used?
opts: Pulsatile delivery mimics physiological GnRH and drives gonadotrophin release
questions.exp: The printed management names pulsatile GnRH to replace the missing hypothalamic signal.

questions.sec: Conditions in the Presence of a Uterus

questions.sec: Conditions in the Presence of a Uterus

questions.sec: Conditions in the Presence of a Uterus
questions.q: True/False: Kallmann syndrome is a hypergonadotropic condition.

questions.sec: Conditions in the Presence of a Uterus

questions.exp: Stature is normal in Kallmann syndrome; short stature belongs to Turner syndrome.

The ovaries failed to secrete estrogen
The urogenital sinus failed to canalise

questions.exp: 'FSH: Normal | Normal'.
